content.text: Build VeriFix for Team HyperX (neatHack 2026) integrating Neatlogs, Entire (Checkpoints + Graph + Brain), and cfo.ai

Built VeriFix 8-focus-area remediation agent with Entire Graph blast-radius guardrail, Entire Brain durable repository memory, Neatlogs full-span tracing & MCP verification (-65.05% prompt tokens, -42.56% latency), and telemetry-coupled cfo.ai financial model.

Integrated Entire Brain v0.1.0 continuous memory (recall, remember, overview, status) and deployed live AWS Lambda patch attestation function (verifix-hyperx-patch-verifier in us-east-1, Account 082229155652) for Team HyperX; verified 8/8 automated tests passing.
